headline: 2019 executive order on free inquiry, transparency, and accountability at colleges and universities that receive federal money.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with free speech and open debate on college campuses, and with making information about colleges more public. It also aims to hold schools more accountable, likely by tying these goals to the federal funding they receive. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, agencies involved, and requirements cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Colleges and universities that receive federal funding
who_it_affects.how: They may face new expectations on campus free speech and on sharing information about their programs.
They may see changes in campus speech policies and in the information available about schools.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 21, 2019; specific deadlines are not stated in the provided material.
